description: Deterministic evaluation questions for the local customer-support policy corpus.

records.question: How many independent identity factors must support verify before resetting a password?
expected_evidence: Verify the customer’s identity using at least two independent factors

records.question: What should the customer-facing status page represent during a service outage?
expected_evidence: Retain a single source of truth for the incident status
update the customer-facing status page or support queues

records.question: Who may approve a documented goodwill refund adjustment?
expected_evidence: a documented goodwill adjustment is approved by the Customer Resolution Manager

records.question: What procedure should an agent follow when handling a password reset request?
expected_evidence: confirm the channel of contact and the account identifier
verify the customer’s identity using at least two independent factors
complete the reset via the approved identity workflow
record the case ID, verification factors used, date and time of the reset

records.question: What steps should support take after a customer reports a failed payment?
expected_evidence: Confirm the failed transaction details
Determine whether the failure is due to a bank decline, card rejection, expired payment method, authorization issue, or system-side payment gateway error
guide the customer through updating the billing details with a secure verification step
Record the root cause, customer communication, action taken, and any follow-up date

records.question: What verification rule applies to password recovery?
expected_evidence: Verify the customer’s identity using at least two independent factors

records.question: What exception rule applies to customer refunds?
expected_evidence: Exceptions to standard eligibility rules may be approved only in these circumstances
All exceptions must be approved, reason-coded, and logged in the refund ledger

records.question: Under policy POL-BILL-014, what should happen when a retryable payment failure is caused by a temporary gateway issue?
expected_evidence: advise the customer to retry the payment once after the stated waiting period
case notes reflect the reason for the retry

records.question: According to POL-OPS-009, when should an outage be escalated to the Incident Commander or Service Reliability Lead?
expected_evidence: the outage impacts multiple customers or regions
there is a risk to sensitive data, compliance obligations, or legal reporting requirements
the support team cannot provide a stable explanation, workaround, or restoration timeline

records.question: What is the company policy for reimbursing employee travel expenses?
Which support policy defines the warehouse shipping address and delivery zones?
What should support do when access is blocked?
expected_evidence: Customer Password Reset Standard covers password recovery and identity verification
Customer Account Access and Authorization Standard covers access permissions and restrictions
